name: TRAPPIST-1f
tagline: Un món ric en aigua a la vora interna de la zona habitable.
history: TRAPPIST-1f announced itself when Spitzer stared at the star for twenty days and the transit pattern snapped into the resonant chain. About Earth's size and mass but less dense, it likely carries a lighter envelope — models favor a water-rich world rather than bare rock. It receives roughly Mars-level starlight inside the optimistic habitable zone, so a modest greenhouse could still keep it temperate. Locked in a 3:2 rhythm with e, it completes the middle trio that makes this system a natural laboratory for the question everyone asks: can an M-dwarf planet keep an atmosphere?
